note: #909. Attach validated the shape of its two names and asked ownership of neither, where Detach asks both. The guard sits in Attach itself, ahead of the agent probe, so it covers every pack at once. Proven through the injectable runner, not against a running Incus. The last mutation's fragment carries Attach's machine-name check as context since #932: the bare condition now matches Start's entry guard too, and falsify:lint refuses a fragment that leaves one of its matches standing. Since #944 Attach asks the network and the pinned address through ownedAttachments, the predicate Start asks, instead of its own copy of the network condition; the mutations that named that copy now name either Attach's call of the predicate (the whole question removed, or refusing everything) or the predicate itself judged by Attach's tests (the machine-name copy-paste, and the shape half, which had no row here before). The last mutation is #934: the instance question asked under the lock it acts under, held by a test that takes the lock itself and watches for the ownership probe. The mutation after it is the same property on Detach, which takes the same lock and removes a device on the strength of the same answer.
